nodes.label: Duplicated DeploymentPhaseController registration
nodes.rationale: DeploymentPhaseController.cpp appears twice in GAME_SOURCES and .h twice in GAME_HEADERS: harmless but drift-prone given the single-source-of-truth policy.

nodes.label: Root CMakeLists as Orchestrator Only
nodes.rationale: The root file configures dependency/engine discovery and delegates target definition to game/CMakeLists.txt so there is exactly one source of truth for the executable source list and no drift.

nodes.label: game/CMakeLists.txt Single Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: All game source/header registration lives here to avoid drift with the root CMakeLists; explicit lists are preferred over globbing.

nodes.label: TRPG_USE_INSTALLED_ENGINE (DEV vs FINAL engine selection)
nodes.rationale: DEV builds consume engine/build's exported package while FINAL builds consume the installed ../install package; paths are cache variables so they are overridable per machine without editing the file.

nodes.label: TRPG::engine / SDL3::SDL3 link
nodes.rationale: The game target links only the engine package and SDL3; the engine is consumed through its exported target, never vendored.

nodes.label: Include directories (src + ../engine/include)
nodes.rationale: src/ is the active implementation and header tree; an include/ tree is added only when a real public game API appears. Adding only ../engine/include mechanically enforces the public-header engine boundary.

nodes.label: POST_BUILD asset copy
nodes.rationale: The assets folder is copied next to the executable so content resolves relative to the binary at runtime.
